articles.title: Bitcoin experts split over plan to freeze Satoshi's 1.1 million bitcoin as quantum threat grows
articles.snippet: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao said Satoshi Nakamoto's bitcoin should be frozen before quantum computers can steal it. Not everyone agrees.

articles.title: What Is Q-Day? The Quantum Threat to Bitcoin Explained
articles.snippet: Experts warn quantum computers could someday forge Bitcoin’s digital signatures, allowing unauthorized transactions.
